framing.subject: single orange fruit character: the whole body is one round orange, not a humanoid torso
framing.body: very chibi: tiny cartoon hands and feet only; expressive promo pose with laptop and pointing finger
framing.background: plain light paper; optional faint desk or monitor silhouette; no text or brand marks

rules.instruction: Clean cartoon line-art hand-drawn look; flat or simple cel shading; no photoreal peel wrinkles, pores, or mottled spots.
Light color wash in bright, saturated cheerful tones.
The main body is the orange sphere itself; only add tiny Q-version hands and feet, no separate human torso, arms, or legs.
Required identity markers stay clearly visible and unobstructed despite the promo pose.
No text, letters, logos, watermark, or extra characters.
